newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Jackin Int'l to kick off road show - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Jackin Int'l to kick off road show - sources.

text.p: Magnetic data storage products manufacturer Jackin International Holdings Ltd is expected to kick off its listing road show with a presentation to analysts on Thursday, market sources said on Monday.
The sources said analysts would be invited to visit the company's manufacturing plant in Hong Kong as part of the presentation.

The Hong Kong-based company is expected to list its shares in late November or early December, with Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd seen as the sponsor of the issue, the sources said. No further details were available, they said.
A company spokesman declined to comment.
